## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: Synthetic test fixture exercises a 6000+ line all-provenanced session\xe2\x86\x92main PR; completes without LLM dispatch.

## Implementation Notes

Create `tests/workflows/test-integration-review-skip-on-provenance.sh`.

**Test approach**:
- Given a fixture session branch with 6000+ lines of changes across multiple commits, EACH commit body contains 'DSO-Story-Merge: <story-id>' (provenanced).
- When llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh is invoked with DSO_BASE_SHA/DSO_SESSION_HEAD pointing to this fixture.
- Then: verify-session-provenance.sh returns exit 0; wrapper emits 'skipped' check-run; ci-llm-review-runner.sh is NEVER invoked (assert via mock or trace).
- And: check-run summary contains 'Covered by sub-PR reviews:' followed by the covering PR numbers.

Test fixture uses mktemp + git init + multi-commit synthesis. Mock gh api responses where needed (PATH override like S6).

Add `.test-index` RED marker `[test_integration_review_skip_on_provenance]`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] E2E test exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/workflows/test-integration-review-skip-on-provenance.sh
- [ ] Test asserts ci-llm-review-runner.sh is NEVER invoked when verifier exits 0
  Verify: grep -qE 'NEVER.*ci-llm-review-runner|assert.*not.invoked' tests/workflows/test-integration-review-skip-on-provenance.sh
- [ ] After T2+T3, test passes
  Verify: bash tests/workflows/test-integration-review-skip-on-provenance.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_integration_review_skip_on_provenance\]' \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
